note: Sonoma coast state park on Hwy 1 north of Jenner, about 18 miles from the nearest gas. Gerstle Cove campground sits in pines west of the highway, a few hundred metres by trail above Gerstle Cove; Woodside's two loops are east of Hwy 1. Pads are mostly level and paved and lengths vary, so the park advises calling about rig size. Campers may fill water and dump free at the Bodega Dunes kiosk with their camping receipt. A self-contained en-route overflow area sits between Gerstle Cove campground and the day-use lot. The visitor center is closed indefinitely. --Claude
summary: parks.ca.gov park + camping pages and ReserveCalifornia API read: $35 at both campgrounds (+$10 extra vehicle), 109 sites (95 on RC, all 31 ft; page max trailer 31 / motorhome 36), no hookups/showers/dump, flush toilets + water; Gerstle Cove year-round, Woodside May 1-Nov 1. Coastal walk confirmed for Gerstle Cove. Split candidate (Gerstle vs Woodside).
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'coastal walk' CONFIRMED for Gerstle Cove campground (sites 1-30, reservable nightly, 25 on ReserveCalifornia). On Esri the campground loops (pin 38.5690,-123.3252) sit in pines west of Hwy 1, which runs along the NE edge of the camp; only the park road, the day-use area and open coastal terrace lie between the camp and Gerstle Cove's shore (~38.5665,-123.3297), roughly 300-500 m away, and the park page names 'trails from campground to cove'. No highway, town, rail or houses between. Woodside (sites 31-109) is east of Hwy 1 and does not qualify (stored evidence already says so).

SITES: max_rig_ft 31 -> 36 (parks.ca.gov 'Max camper/motorhome: 36 feet'; max trailer 31). ReserveCalifornia gives every web unit VehicleLength 31 and one Woodside Lower unit at 36 ft that isn't web-bookable; pad lengths mostly 36 ft, GC10 is 22 ft. A 23-ft rig fits.

SPLIT CANDIDATE: Gerstle Cove Campground (sites 1-30; 25 units on ReserveCalifornia; centroid 38.56887,-123.32481; year-round; phone (707) 847-3221; RC facility 648) vs Woodside Campground (sites 31-109; Lower Loop 35 units at 38.56568,-123.31239, RC facility 649; Upper Loop 35 units at 38.56635,-123.30763, RC facility 614; May 1-Nov 1; phone (707) 847-3290), about 1.1-1.5 km apart across Hwy 1, with their own loops, kiosk/phone and season.
